skins.name: Glory to the Devout
skins.code: Test Collection Series/Glory to the Devout
skins.description: Nun's habit that has been altered, with adjustments for the wearer's racial characteristics. Paired with accessories that reflect one's personal style.

skins.name: Bard by the Lake
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bard by the Lake
skins.description: Attire Cantabile wore during her lakeside holiday. The white of the dress is in perfect harmony with the natural environment, creating a tranquil, dream-like ambience.

skins.name: Judgment Day
skins.description: Gun-Knight Fiammetta returns to where her squad fell apart. Fragments of time have turned into vicious beasts, intent on bringing everything in the area into stasis. Without the slightest hesitation, she pulls the trigger.

skins.name: A Player Forever
skins.description: Outfit Mizuki wears when he plays games in Higashi. A perfect fusion of stylish street fashion and retro game elements, letting Mizuki show off his gamer style at max settings.

skins.name: Roar Against The Wilds
skins.description: Młynar's iteration from decision point F/3019226. The Black Riders have finally arrived at the Forgotten Plains, but the Hermit Knight chooses not to leave. Instead, he bars the way, alone.

skins.name: Supernova
skins.description: Clothes Wiš'adel wears when stepping into the unknown of space to corral Originium run wild. According to her, since she's here to clean up the trash, she should wear something suitable for the occasion.

skins.name: Moonlit Voyage
skins.description: Themed around the night sky, the moon and oceanic voyages, the dream-like weave of star and sea feels like going on a antastical journey, with drifting moon and stars as companions.
skins.howToObtain: Reach Doctor level 80 and have a cumulative sign-in amount of 1000 days

skins.name: Primordial Ode
skins.description: PhonoR-0 is draped in the lace veil her sisters embroidered with incantations, singing an ode above the Valley. The banshees have finally found their voice once more.

skins.name: Caelum Aeternum
skins.description: 斗争血脉系列/天穹肇始。危难与困境从来都不会只停留在某个瞬间，真正的卫士守护着永恒交替的昼夜，一刻不休。信仰搅拌机，正为此而生。
